تنتقلوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِلُوا (tantaqilū) /tan.ta.qi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# تُنْتَقَلُوا (tuntaqalū) /tun.ta.qa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
